answer: The Sybil defence here is stake scaling with identity count. Each agent must hold its own non-transferable ledge of bonded value while active, and duplicates traced to one operator are slashed. Proof of personhood fails, since one key can script many agents. Running N fakes means locking N times the minimum stake in value it cannot recycle, so cost grows linearly while reward per fake stays flat and the attack stops paying. The cipher securing that ledger must be audited, or a forged balance reopens the door. In short, weight voice by capital at risk and keep a falcon eye on cluster detection.
